heading: One pass finds your start
body: **Gas Station** is a greedy scan problem. If total gas ≥ total cost, a solution exists. Walk the circle once: when your tank dips below zero, **reset start to the next station**. Why? Any station between the old start and failure point would fail even sooner.

heading: The greedy reset trick
body:
**Key insight**: if you can't reach station `i+1` starting from `s`, then starting from any station between `s` and `i` will also fail — you'd have even less fuel.

**Action**: reset `start = i+1` and `fuel = 0`; continue scanning.

q: What is the time complexity of the greedy gas station solution?
explain: We make a single pass through all n stations, performing O(1) work at each station.
